in_marathi.name: Devraaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deva (God) + Raja (King). The name Devraaj is derived from the Sanskrit words Deva (God) and Raja (King). In Hindu mythology, this name is often given to a king or ruler who is considered divine or a god himself.
